mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock recovery phase (indicated by rising industrial production), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in improved economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has risen for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 4-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals robust labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for at least 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening supply conditions that support economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has increased for at least 3 months, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falls below its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer demand that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
